result.note: Tests the August 2026 move to treat rupee export earnings on par with dollars and euros for trade-policy benefits and its purpose of promoting rupee settlement.

questions.prompt: In August 2026, India changed how export earnings received in rupees are treated. Consider the following statements about this change:
items: Rupee export earnings were put on the same footing as earnings in dollars and euros for trade-policy benefits.
The move is intended to nudge exporters towards settling trade in rupees.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Both are correct. Exporters paid in rupees now get the same trade-policy benefits as those paid in dollars or euros, which nudges them towards rupee settlement. The step came as Trump warned BRICS against challenging the dollar.
questions.source: India put rupee export earnings on the same footing as dollars and euros for trade-policy benefits, nudging exporters towards rupee settlement as Trump warns BRICS against challenging the dollar.
